stage13a_bsds_transfer.description: Frozen Stage-12d transfer to BSDS500 test. One-shot external validation; no tuning from this result.

stage13b_protocol_research.description: Research-planning checkpoint for BIPED frozen replication and official Berkeley evaluation. No external-test tuning is permitted.

stage13c_biped_preflight.description: Read-only validation of the manually obtained BIPEDv2 split and frozen Stage-12d artifact before external replication.

stage13d_biped_transfer.description: One-shot frozen Stage-12d replication on the author-designated BIPEDv2 test split at native resolution; fixed-threshold diagnostics only.

stage14a_research_checkpoint.description: Literature-guided planning checkpoint for a new development-only MFI-Edge generation. Chooses one minimal falsification experiment without using external-test feedback for optimization.

stage14b_polarity_ablation.description: Leakage-free repeated-CV mechanism ablation on UDED selection only: test whether spatially aligned anti-texture evidence adds value beyond positive-only, image-mean negative, and no-negative ratio controls.

stage14c_positive_bank_pruning.description: Leakage-free repeated-CV pruning test on UDED selection only: compare the fold-trained full positive signature bank against a compact subset of universally stable positive features, with identical positive-only aggregation and fold-fitted thresholds.

stage14d_persistence_feature_ablation.description: Leakage-free repeated-CV ablation on UDED selection only: compare the validated five-feature compact positive bank with the same bank minus scale persistence, keeping aggregation, localization, gating, and fold-fitted thresholds fixed.

stage14e_rdf_protocol_checkpoint.description: Literature-guided checkpoint to preregister a controlled development-only RDF/d-Choquet robustness experiment after Stage 14d retained the five-feature compact positive bank.

stage14f_rdf_robustness.description: Paired synthetic validation falsification of d-CC with FBPC and absolute RDF against the frozen five-feature positive distorted-Choquet control; clean-only calibration thresholds are fixed across corruption strata.

stage14g_post_rdf_research_checkpoint.description: Literature-guided research checkpoint after the preregistered d-CC robustness falsification failed promotion; choose one mechanistically distinct development-only next test without external-test feedback.

stage14h_gravity_smoothing.description: Paired synthetic development falsification of replacing the median prefilter with fixed gravitational smoothing, holding the compact positive controller and Scharr+NMS architecture fixed.

stage14i_topology_repair.description: Leakage-free repeated-CV natural-image falsification of fixed MFI-guided geodesic endpoint linking after the compact positive controller; linker parameters are transferred unchanged from Stage-4 synthetic development.

stage14j_phase_congruency.description: Leakage-free repeated-CV natural-image falsification of one fixed-default phase-congruency maximum-moment feature appended to the retained compact positive context bank.

stage14k_color_tensor_localizer.description: Leakage-free repeated-CV natural-image falsification of replacing the grayscale Scharr+NMS localizer with a fixed CIELAB Di Zenzo tensor Scharr+NMS localizer under the retained compact positive context gate.

stage14l_texture_distribution_context.description: Leakage-free repeated-CV natural-image falsification of one fixed oriented half-disc LBP texture-distribution feature appended to the retained compact positive context bank.

stage14m_logistic_cue_fusion.description: Leakage-free repeated-CV falsification of a class-balanced linear logistic probability-of-boundary fusion over the retained compact memberships and Scharr+NMS support.

stage14n_shallow_edge_forest.description: Leakage-free repeated-CV falsification of a bounded shallow randomized forest that predicts a dense boundary score from raw Scharr and the retained compact signature before fixed gradient-direction NMS.

stage14o_interval_capacity_uncertainty.description: Leakage-free repeated-CV falsification of interval-valued compact memberships with a cue-disagreement reliability field, convex Choquet-to-additive capacity interpolation, and interval-width attenuation; includes default-on official BSDS500-validation evaluation.

stage14o_official_eval_retry.description: Attachment-only retry of the frozen Stage-14o candidate and incumbent under official BSDS500-validation MATLAB evaluation after repairing the incumbent export import path; does not rerun repeated CV or change the candidate.

stage14o_official_eval_retry2.description: Second attachment-only retry of the frozen Stage-14o candidate and incumbent under official BSDS500-validation MATLAB evaluation after making the candidate exporter robust to absolute-path launch; does not rerun repeated CV or change the candidate.

stage14o_official_eval_retry3.description: Third attachment-only retry of the frozen Stage-14o candidate and incumbent under official BSDS500-validation MATLAB evaluation after correcting the wrapper's MEX-file existence check; does not rerun repeated CV or change the candidate.

stage14o_official_eval_retry4.description: Fourth attachment-only retry of the frozen Stage-14o candidate and incumbent under official BSDS500-validation MATLAB evaluation using a run-local syntax-only compatibility mirror for the pinned Berkeley per-image evaluator; does not edit vendored code, rerun repeated CV, or change the candidate.

stage14o_official_eval_retry5.description: Fifth attachment-only retry of the frozen Stage-14o candidate and incumbent under official BSDS500-validation MATLAB evaluation after removing the pinned evaluator's unused unsupported fourth fileparts output in the run-local compatibility mirror; does not edit vendored code, rerun repeated CV, regenerate predictions, or change the candidate.

stage14o_official_eval_retry6.description: Sixth attachment-only retry of the frozen Stage-14o candidate and incumbent under official BSDS500-validation MATLAB evaluation, isolating native per-image matching from pure-MATLAB aggregation in fresh processes after a post-matching heap-corruption failure; does not edit vendored code, rerun repeated CV, regenerate predictions, or change the candidate.

stage14p_ambrosio_tortorelli.description: Leakage-free repeated-CV falsification of one fixed MFI-coupled Ambrosio-Tortorelli phase field as a variational localization replacement for gated grayscale Scharr+NMS; includes default-on official BSDS500-validation evaluation.

stage14q_shearlet_localizer.description: Leakage-free repeated-CV falsification of one fixed small anisotropic directional atom bank as a singularity localizer replacing Scharr under the unchanged compact Choquet context gate; includes default-on official BSDS500-validation evaluation.

stage14q_official_eval_retry.description: Attachment-only retry of the frozen Stage-14q candidate and incumbent under official BSDS500-validation MATLAB evaluation after an intermittent native-matching heap-corruption exit; does not rerun repeated CV, alter predictions, or change the candidate.

stage14r_se2_contour_enhancement.description: Leakage-free repeated-CV falsification of one fixed confidence-stopped SE(2) tangent/angular diffusion applied to the retained compact Choquet-gated Scharr score; includes continuity diagnostics and default-on official BSDS500-validation evaluation.

stage14s_fractional_riesz_localizer.description: Leakage-free repeated-CV falsification of one fixed half-order isotropic Riesz-gradient localizer under the retained compact Choquet context gate; includes default-on official BSDS500-validation evaluation.

stage14t_acontrario_meaningfulness.description: Leakage-free repeated-CV falsification of one fixed a-contrario connected-support meaningfulness gate over the unchanged compact Choquet-gated Scharr score; includes default-on official BSDS500-validation evaluation.

stage14t_official_eval_retry.description: Attachment-only retry of the frozen Stage-14t candidate and incumbent under official BSDS500-validation MATLAB evaluation after an intermittent native-matching heap-corruption exit; does not rerun repeated CV, alter predictions, or change the candidate.

stage14u_yager_evidential_ignorance.description: Leakage-free repeated-CV falsification of one fixed three-source Yager-rule evidence fusion with explicit edge, non-edge, conflict, and ignorance masses under the retained Scharr gate; includes default-on official BSDS500-validation evaluation.

stage14u_official_eval_retry.description: Attachment-only retry of the frozen Stage-14u candidate and incumbent under official BSDS500-validation MATLAB evaluation after an intermittent native-matching heap-corruption exit; does not rerun repeated CV, alter predictions, or change the candidate.

stage14u_official_eval_retry2.description: Second attachment-only retry of the frozen Stage-14u candidate and incumbent under official BSDS500-validation MATLAB evaluation, resuming completed per-image Berkeley matches across fresh processes after repeated intermittent heap-corruption exits; does not rerun CV, alter predictions, edit vendor sources, or change the candidate.

stage15a_protocol_audit.description: Reproduce the pinned five-image Berkeley boundary-evaluator fixture, audit BSDS500-validation protocol/data invariants, and establish fixed Canny, repository Scharr+NMS, and unchanged-incumbent measurement floors without altering MFI architecture.

stage15a_fixture_diagnostic.description: Architecture-free evaluator diagnostic that quantifies the preregistered five-image Berkeley fixture mismatch, preserves shipped/local table and evaluator-source hashes, and determines the next fidelity repair without relaxing tolerance or scoring the full validation split.

stage15a_evaluator_path_equivalence.description: Fixture-only evaluator fidelity diagnostic comparing the repository's syntax-compatible pinned Berkeley image path against Piotr Dollar's documented BSDS-compatible edgesEvalImg path with the same pinned Windows matcher, repeated in fresh MATLAB processes; no validation scoring, tolerance change, or architecture work.

stage15a_evaluator_path_equivalence_retr.description: Attachment-only retry of the fixture path-equivalence diagnostic after supplying the pinned edges evaluator's missing Piotr Dollar toolbox parameter-parser dependency through a strict repository-local name/value compatibility shim; no validation scoring, tolerance change, vendored edit, or architecture work.

Second attachment-only retry of the fixture path-equivalence diagnostic after correcting the local harness to pass the shipped single-channel PNG boundary predictions, rather than the RGB source photographs, to edgesEvalImg; no validation scoring, tolerance change, vendored edit, or architecture work.

stage15a_source_matcher_rebuild.description: Fixture-only build diagnostic compiling correspondPixels from the exact pinned BSDS500 C++ sources with the selected MATLAB compiler, then repeating the shipped five-image fixture in fresh processes; no validation scoring, tolerance change, vendored edit, or architecture work.

stage15a_source_matcher_rebuild_retry.description: Attachment-only retry of the fixture source-build diagnostic after adding a repository-local MSVC compatibility include layer for the pinned Unix-era sources; vendored matcher sources remain byte-unchanged and no validation scoring, tolerance change, evaluator-logic change, or architecture work is performed.

stage15a_source_matcher_rebuild_retry2.description: Second attachment-only retry of the fixture source-build diagnostic after normalizing Windows path separators in the repository-local matcher-resolution assertion; the successfully rebuilt matcher, vendored source bytes, fixture, tolerance, evaluator logic, validation policy, and architecture remain unchanged.

stage15a_source_matcher_rebuild_retry3.description: Third attachment-only retry of the fixture source-build diagnostic after applying the already-audited repository-local MATLAB R2023a syntax compatibility mirror to the fixture harness; vendored evaluator and matcher sources, rebuilt matching logic, fixture, tolerance, validation policy, and architecture remain unchanged.

stage15a_seed_determinism_diagnostic.description: Final fixture-only Stage-15a causal diagnostic fixing the pinned matcher's documented clock-seeded global RNG to predeclared seed 1 in a result-local source copy, then repeating the unchanged five-image fixture in fresh MATLAB processes; the controlled binary cannot score datasets.

stage15b_sed_reproduction_checkpoint.description: High-reasoning live-literature and provenance checkpoint to specify one exact or fidelity-labeled reproduction of Akbarinia and Parraga's SED after Stage 15a closed without evaluator reference verification; no detector maps or architecture changes occur in this checkpoint.

stage15b_sed_exact_reproduction.description: Exact unmodified author-MATLAB reproduction of the fixed, strictly untrained SED full model on native-resolution BSDS500 validation, with per-image maps/runtime/hashes, deterministic positions 1/50/100 preview, and matched official attachment against the unchanged incumbent.

stage15b_sed_exact_reproduction_retry1.description: Harness-only retry of the exact Stage-15b author-MATLAB SED reproduction after adding a process-local Git safe.directory override for the immutable, hash-verified ignored author checkout; detector sources, parameters, data, serialization, preview positions, and evaluation protocol are unchanged.

stage15c_vcm_reproduction_checkpoint.description: High-reasoning live-literature and provenance checkpoint for the Stage-15c vector co-occurrence morphological colour-edge audit after exact SED reproduction; resolves code, fixed parameters, training class, and metric compatibility before any detector run.

stage15c_vcm_fidelity_preflight.description: Deterministic, dataset-free fidelity preflight for Lu et al.'s vector co-occurrence morphological colour-edge detector after the primary paper exposed no author code and insufficient fixed detail for an exact or faithful run; records the implementation contract without inventing parameters or scoring a surrogate.

stage15d_ed_edpf_reproduction_checkpoint.description: High-reasoning live-literature and provenance checkpoint for exact Edge Drawing / EDPF reproduction after Stage 15c closed as fidelity-unresolved; resolves official code lineage, fixed parameters, training class, buildability, output convention, and metric compatibility before any detector run.

stage15d_edpf_build_preflight.description: Dataset-free dependency and exact-source preflight for grayscale EDPF at the immutable MIT-licensed ED_Lib author commit; verifies hashes, attempts an external CMake build of unmodified sources, and runs a deterministic synthetic binary-output smoke test before any BSDS execution.

stage15d_edpf_build_preflight_retry1.description: Attachment-only dependency/build retry for the exact grayscale EDPF source after the workstation lacked OpenCV C++ development files; bootstraps pinned OpenCV 3.4.20 from immutable upstream source, then repeats the unchanged dataset-free build and deterministic binary-output smoke test.

stage15d_edpf_build_preflight_retry2.description: Attachment-only retry after correcting the OpenCV 3.4.20 annotated-tag provenance check: verifies immutable tag object 404ca455 and its peeled release commit 1eb1d4c, then repeats the unchanged dataset-free dependency build and exact EDPF binary-output smoke test.

stage15d_edpf_build_preflight_retry3.description: Attachment-only retry after the pinned OpenCV build succeeded but its obsolete top-level Windows-pack dispatcher could not classify MSVC 19.42; selects the exact installed static-package config and repeats the unchanged dataset-free EDPF compile/smoke test.

stage15d_edpf_build_preflight_retry4.description: Attachment-only retry after OpenCV 3.4's generated static package referenced unbuilt unused codec targets; directly imports the exact installed core/imgproc/zlib artifacts and repeats the unchanged dataset-free EDPF compile/smoke test.

stage15d_edpf_build_preflight_retry5.description: Attachment-only retry after the grayscale-only harness unnecessarily compiled EDColor.cpp, whose unused diagnostic imwrite call requires the excluded imgcodecs module; limits compilation to the exact ED.cpp/EDPF.cpp source surface needed by the selected grayscale constructor and repeats the unchanged synthetic smoke test.

stage15d_edpf_build_preflight_retry6.description: Attachment-only retry after the exact grayscale source reached linking but exposed a static-runtime mismatch and ED.cpp's same-object dependency on EDColor symbols; builds pinned OpenCV core/imgproc/imgcodecs, matches its /MT runtime, compiles unmodified ED.cpp/EDColor.cpp/EDPF.cpp, and repeats the unchanged synthetic smoke test.

stage15d_edpf_build_preflight_retry7.description: Attachment-only retry after OpenCV 3.4's generated static export table rejected absent unused libprotobuf/quirc archives before author compilation; directly imports the exact installed core/imgproc/imgcodecs and codec artifacts, preserves the matched /MT runtime and unmodified ED.cpp/EDColor.cpp/EDPF.cpp sources, and repeats the unchanged synthetic smoke test.

stage15d_edpf_exact_reproduction.description: Exact unmodified-author-code grayscale EDPF reproduction on all 100 native-resolution BSDS500 validation images after the pinned build preflight passed; preserves the native binary map, records per-image runtime/hashes, emits the fixed positions 1/50/100 preview, and attaches the common official evaluator against the unchanged incumbent.

stage15e_co_sco_reproduction_checkpoint.description: High-reasoning live-primary-literature and official-code audit of the Stage-15e CO/SCO contextual color baselines after exact EDPF reproduction; resolves immutable provenance, fixed variants and parameters, training class, output conventions, and matched BSDS500-validation feasibility before any detector run.

stage15e_co_sco_exact_reproduction.description: Paired exact-author-code CO/SCO reproduction on all 100 native-resolution BSDS500-validation images using the fixed 2015 published setting; preserves separate soft maps, runtimes and hashes, isolates the published spatial-sparseness step, emits fixed positions 1/50/100 preview, and attaches the common official evaluator against the unchanged incumbent.

stage15f_compass_reproduction_checkpoint.description: High-reasoning live-primary-literature and official-code audit of the Stage-15f Compass distribution-gradient baseline after exact CO/SCO reproduction; resolves code availability, immutable provenance, fixed parameters, training class, output conventions, and matched BSDS500-validation feasibility before any detector run.

stage15f_compass_build_preflight.description: Dataset-free hash-verified build and repeatability preflight of Ruzon and Tomasi's unmodified author Compass MATLAB/C MEX code at the preregistered published sigma-4 edge setting; no benchmark dataset is read and no surrogate is permitted.

stage15f_compass_build_preflight_retry1.description: Attachment-only build retry after the unchanged 2004 Compass gateway compiled under MATLAB's default 64-bit array-dimension ABI but its legacy int dimension vector was interpreted as an enormous allocation; rebuilds the same hash-verified author bytes with MATLAB's compatible array-dimensions mode and repeats the unchanged dataset-free synthetic smoke test.

stage15f_compass_exact_reproduction.description: Exact unmodified-author-code Compass reproduction on all 100 native-resolution BSDS500-validation images at the preregistered published sigma-4 setting; preserves the maximum-EMD maps, runtimes and hashes, emits the fixed positions 1/50/100 preview, and attaches the common official evaluator against the unchanged incumbent.

stage15f_compass_exact_reproduction_retr.description: Attachment-only finalization of the 100 frozen Stage-15f Compass maps after MATLAB emitted its completion marker and then exited with Windows heap corruption; validates the existing maps/runtime rows, writes hashes/provenance/preview/manifest, and attaches the unchanged official evaluator without invoking Compass or regenerating predictions.

stage15g_texture_surround_reproduction_c.description: High-reasoning live-primary-literature and official-code audit of the Stage-15g texture-gradient plus surround-modulation detector after exact Compass reproduction; resolves code availability, immutable provenance, fixed parameters, training class, output conventions, and matched BSDS500-validation feasibility before any detector run.

stage15g_texture_surround_fidelity_prefl.description: Deterministic dataset-free fidelity preflight for Yang, Peng and Wu's 2025 texture-gradient plus surround-modulation detector after the audit found no article-specific code and non-equivalent output-affecting details across a same-inventor patent and the official related BESD repository; records the implementation contract without inventing a hybrid surrogate.

stage15h_adaptive_surround_reproduction_.description: High-reasoning live-primary-literature and official-code audit of Zhang et al.'s adaptive multiscale V1 surround-modulation contour detector after Stage 15g closed fidelity-unresolved; resolves code availability, immutable provenance, fixed parameters, training class, output conventions, and matched BSDS500-validation feasibility before any detector run.

stage15h_adaptive_surround_fidelity_pref.description: Deterministic dataset-free fidelity preflight for Zhang et al.'s adaptive multiscale V1 surround-modulation detector after the live audit found no article-specific code or supplement and an incomplete public executable contract; records unresolved filtering, adaptation, fusion, output, and metric conventions without inventing a surrogate.

stage15i_fractional_reference_reproducti.description: High-reasoning live-primary-literature and official-code audit of the 2026 Fractional Dirac edge detector after Stage 15h closed fidelity-unresolved; resolves implementation fidelity, fixed parameters, training class, output conventions, distinction from Stage 14s, and matched BSDS500-validation feasibility before any detector run.

stage15i_qfrd_runtime_preflight.description: Dataset-free immutable-source and runtime preflight of Huang, Hu and Lian's official QFrD author code at commit 8dcc8d846e6dcbe1bc4b931b89f1c814f5f9a245; records the paper/code multiplication-order caveat, dependency state, source hashes, and fixed-default synthetic repeatability without reading BSDS or changing any author byte.

stage15i_qfrd_runtime_preflight_retry1.description: Harness-only retry after the first dataset-free QFrD preflight exposed an incomplete --no-checkout clone and confirmed missing PyTorch dependencies; uses a fresh ignored checkout, installs the pinned CPU tensor runtime, and repeats the unchanged immutable-source and synthetic-repeatability checks without reading BSDS or altering author bytes or detector parameters.

stage15i_qfrd_exact_reproduction.description: Exact pinned-author-code QFrD reproduction at the published fixed defaults over all 100 native-resolution BSDS500-validation images after the immutable-source/runtime preflight passed; preserves soft maps, runtimes and hashes, emits the fixed positions 1/50/100 preview, and attaches the unchanged official evaluator against the incumbent.

stage15j_high_number_protocol_audit_chec.description: High-reasoning live-primary-literature protocol audit of recent non-trained edge detectors with unusually high reported F/F1 values after the exact QFrD reproduction; resolves metric/evaluator compatibility and selects at most one fidelity-labeled next reproduction or advances to Stage 15k without changing MFI.

stage15k_per_image_oracle_matrix.description: Frozen-output BSDS500-validation diagnosis across the unchanged MFI incumbent and exact Stage-15 SED, EDPF, CO, SCO, Compass, and QFrD references; parses existing official per-image count tables to produce fixed-threshold and per-image-best precision/recall/F1, pairwise win/loss matrices, and a descriptive method-oracle upper bound without rerunning any detector or matcher.

stage15l_image_regime_characterization.description: Predeclared BSDS500-validation image-regime diagnosis over frozen Stage-15 outputs; measures texture, contrast, edge density, fragmentation, orientation/curvature, scale distribution, GT density, and annotator agreement, then relates them descriptively to fixed-threshold method deltas without fitting a router or rerunning detectors/matcher.

stage15m_pixel_segment_complementarity.description: Predeclared BSDS500-validation pixel/segment complementarity diagnosis over frozen MFI, SED, EDPF, CO, SCO, Compass, and QFrD outputs at their already reported ODS thresholds; quantifies unique GT-supported responses, shared unsupported responses, weak-gradient support, and connected-component continuity without fitting a router or changing MFI.

stage15n_uded_bsds_discrepancy_audit.description: Predeclared cross-development-dataset discrepancy audit using only UDED-selection Stage-14r/14s repeated-CV tables, existing BSDS500-validation official count tables, and fixed image-internal regime measures; tests which distribution/error-regime differences accompany the opposite SE(2) and fractional deltas without rerunning a detector or matcher, fitting a router, or changing MFI.

stage15o_texture_evidence_decomposition.description: Final preregistered Stage-15 diagnostic: decompose fixed analytic interior-texture activity, cross-boundary texture-distribution contrast, local gradient, multiscale persistence, and structural chain support on UDED selection and BSDS500 validation using deterministic samples and image-blocked diagnostic models; no detector candidate, router, matcher rerun, or MFI architecture change.

stage15o_texture_evidence_decomposition_.description: Harness-only retry of the unchanged Stage-15o diagnostic after replacing its undeclared scikit-learn runtime dependency with repository-supported SciPy implementations of the same fold-fitted standardization, class-balanced L2 logistic probe, ROC AUC, and average precision contract; no dataset, cue, sample, fold, decision rule, detector, matcher, or MFI architecture changes.

stage16a_generation2_mechanism_checkpoin.description: High-reasoning live-primary-literature checkpoint after Stage 15o failed its cross-dataset texture gate; synthesizes the completed reproduction and diagnostic evidence and registers exactly one bounded, interpretable, non-neural generation-2 falsification without changing the incumbent.

stage16b_fixed_sed_mfi_fusion.description: Preregistered generation-2 falsification of one fixed equal arithmetic mean of the compact MFI soft map and exact author-code SED; evaluates both constituents and the fusion on UDED-selection 5x3 leakage-free CV and official BSDS500 validation under a conjunctive rule, with no learned weight, router, dataset identity, or protected feedback.

autonomous_literature_escalation.description: Repeatable high-reasoning live-web research checkpoint used automatically whenever the current development iteration has no hard blocker, the generalized SOTA goal is not reached, and no immediate next experiment is registered.
